preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 1,000,000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 1,000,000, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The number of selected vertices is at least one.

postconditions.expression: all(x not in graph[y] for x in Q for y in Q)
postconditions.description: No two selected vertices are connected by an edge.

postconditions.expression: all(any(x in graph[z] or y in graph[z] for z in graph[x] or y in graph[x]) for y not in Q for x in Q)
postconditions.description: Any vertex not in the set Q is reachable from some vertex in Q in at most two moves.
